dct_description_sm: Our goal was to determine the level of recognition of Canadian Arctic science in the deliberative bodies of the federal and territorial governments. Our inquiry was limited to references to two of the most recent Big Science programs, ArcticNet (2003 to 2012) and the International Polar Year (2004-2012).
